newsitem.title: USA: White House says Clinton to visit Venezuela.
newsitem.headline: White House says Clinton to visit Venezuela.

text.p: U.S. President Bill Clinton will visit Venezuela during his tour of Latin America and the Caribbean in May, the White House announced on Wednesday.

White House spokesman Mike McCurry made the announcement, saying he was not yet able to disclose the dates of the visit. The White House announced in February Clinton planned to visit Barbados, Costa Rica, Brazil and Argentina May 6-13.
